meta.purpose: FP&A and CFO Skills Academy — the planning, reporting and influence cycle that turns accounting into decision support.
meta.standard: Every deliverable must answer three questions: what happened, why did it happen, and what should we do.

rolling: Re-forecast the next 4–6 quarters each month
Refresh key drivers only, not the full build
Maintain a single forecast version of truth

topics.name: Annual Budgeting
topics.outcome: Run a budget cycle that produces a plan people actually use.
topics.practice: Build the budget calendar and assumption register for a ₹500 crore company, then challenge three department submissions and document the changes.
topics.deliverable: Budget pack + assumption register + challenge log

topics.name: Rolling Forecasts
topics.outcome: Keep a live view of the year instead of a stale January budget.
topics.practice: Convert an annual budget into a rolling forecast and re-forecast three times with new information, tracking forecast bias.

topics.name: Financial Planning
topics.outcome: Link strategy, capacity and capital to a financial plan.
topics.practice: Produce a three-year plan with an explicit capacity constraint and show the funding requirement.

topics.name: Management Reporting
topics.outcome: Report so that a decision can be taken in the meeting.
topics.practice: Design a monthly pack template with a one-page executive summary, a variance page and a driver appendix.

topics.name: Budget versus Actual Analysis
topics.outcome: Explain a variance in one page with the right root cause.
topics: Volume, price, mix, rate and efficiency
topics.practice: For a month with an 8% revenue miss and a 3% cost overrun, decompose the variance and write the commentary a CFO would accept.

topics.name: Variance Analysis (Cost and Revenue)
topics.outcome: Apply standard costing logic to commercial performance.
topics.practice: Decompose gross margin change for a three-product business into price, volume, mix and cost effects.

topics.name: Revenue Forecasting
topics.outcome: Forecast revenue from drivers with a stated confidence range.
topics.practice: Build a revenue forecast for a subscription plus services business, with a probability-weighted range.

topics.name: Expense Forecasting
topics.outcome: Forecast cost by behaviour, not by last year plus inflation.
topics: Cost per unit vs total cost
topics.practice: Forecast operating expenses for a 200-person company with headcount growth and three contract renewals.

topics.name: Cash Flow Forecasting
topics.outcome: Give the business 13 weeks of visibility on cash.
topics.practice: Build a 13-week cash flow forecast and identify the week the business breaches its minimum cash covenant, with three levers to avoid it.

topics.name: Scenario Planning
topics.outcome: Give management options instead of a single number.
topics.practice: Build three scenarios for a demand shock of −20%, −10% and +5%, with the management action for each.

topics.name: Sensitivity Analysis
topics.outcome: Identify which assumption actually determines the outcome.
topics.practice: Produce a tornado chart for a plan and identify the three assumptions that must be monitored monthly.

topics.name: KPI Development
topics.outcome: Define measures precisely enough that two people compute the same number.
topics.practice: Write a KPI dictionary for 15 measures, including formula, source, owner, frequency and known distortions.

topics.name: Business Partnering
topics.outcome: Be the person operations calls before making a decision, not after.
topics.practice: Prepare for a business partner meeting with a sales head who missed target, including the questions to ask and the data to bring.
topics.deliverable: Meeting plan + role-play recording or notes

topics.name: Financial Presentations
topics.outcome: Present numbers so the audience remembers the message.
topics.practice: Present a five-slide performance review to a simulated management team and take three challenge questions.

topics.name: Executive and Board Reporting
topics.outcome: Produce governance-grade reporting with appropriate disclosure.
topics.practice: Draft a board finance section covering performance, liquidity, covenants and outlook in four pages.

projects.title: Annual Operating Budget
projects.brief: Build the full annual operating budget for a fictional manufacturer from drivers, with department P&Ls and a board summary.
projects.dataset: Synthetic prior-year actuals, headcount list, price list, supplier contracts, capex plan.
steps: Revenue build by product and channel
Cost build: material, labour, overheads, SG&A
Department P&L and cost centre allocation
Consolidated budgeted P&L and balance sheet
Board summary with three key messages

projects.title: Three-Statement Financial Model
projects.brief: A five-year integrated model with scenario switching, a debt schedule and a dashboard.
projects.dataset: Three years of synthetic historical financials, debt terms, capex plan, working capital history.
steps: Cash flow and balance sheet integration

projects.title: Monthly MIS Report
projects.brief: Produce a complete monthly management information pack from raw extracts.
projects.dataset: GL extract, cost centre master, budget, headcount, sales register.
steps: Build actual vs budget vs prior month

projects.title: Department-wise Profitability
projects.brief: Allocate costs to departments and identify which ones create or destroy value.
projects.dataset: Department revenue and direct costs, overhead pool, floor area, headcount, transactions.
steps: Define allocation bases and justify them

projects.title: Cash Flow Forecasting
projects.brief: A 13-week rolling cash forecast with covenant monitoring and levers.
projects.dataset: Opening cash, receivables ageing, payables schedule, payroll, debt service, capex commitments.

projects.title: Budget Variance Dashboard
projects.brief: An interactive dashboard showing variance by department, driver and period with exception flags.
projects.dataset: Budget and actual by cost centre and month, headcount, volume drivers.
steps: Build measures for variance and variance %

projects.title: Business Performance Review
projects.brief: A quarterly performance review document with diagnosis, not description.
projects.dataset: Three years of financials, KPI history, competitive context notes.
steps: Analyse performance across the balanced scorecard perspectives
Decompose the key margin and cash movements
Propose a 90-day action plan with owners

projects.title: Management Reporting Presentation
projects.brief: Deliver a 10-slide management pack and present it live.
projects.dataset: The MIS pack produced in project 3.
steps: Define the single message for the period
Build the bridge and driver slides
Add the outlook and the ask

simulations.name: The margin squeeze
simulations.scenario: A ₹300 crore consumer goods company has seen gross margin fall 380 bps over four quarters while revenue grew 9%. Sales attributes it to discounting; operations blames input costs; procurement says volumes fell. You are the new FP&A lead.
decisions: Decompose the margin change into price, discount, mix, input cost and volume effects
Identify which function's explanation is supported by the data
Recommend three interventions with expected impact
Design the monthly report that would have caught this earlier

simulations.name: The covenant test
simulations.scenario: A leveraged manufacturer has a net debt/EBITDA covenant of 3.5x tested quarterly. Forecasts show 3.8x at the next test date. The bank must be informed, and the board needs options.
decisions: Rebuild the forecast and stress it
Test each available lever: working capital, capex deferral, cost action, equity injection
Quantify the effect of each on the covenant
simulations.deliverable: Covenant model + option paper + bank letter
